SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.1, Special Branch. Status.
Date April 3, 1933

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / The N.S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 40112 / D.t. __ / __）

Subject (in full) Japanese naval men - recreation area extended.

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by Tho Robertson Supt

On April 2nd, 1933, the officer i/c Japanese naval
Barracks, Gordon Road, informed Bubbling Well Road Station,
that :-

"Every Saturday, Sunday and on Japanese Memorial Days
the Japanese naval men will be allowed to stroll in B'Well, Louza,
Sinza and Central Districts, and the Japanese Authorities
will have their patrols out to maintain order."

A Naval Patrol, five strong, carrying pistols, bayonets
and batons was observed by the undersigned walking east
on the footpath of Nanking Road, near Honan Road, during
the morning of April 2, 1933.

Sansom
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：A similar patrol was also observed on Yuyuen Road
the same day. On the forenoon of Friday, March 31,
about a hundred Japanese marines carried out
manoeuvres in Jessfield Park.
TR）

（左侧边缘手写字迹：Th / b/s）

报告
S.1，特别支部。状况。
日期 1933年4月3日

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 北区分处登记室。/ 编号 D 40112 / 日期 __ / __）

事由（全称）日本海军人员 - 休闲区域扩大。

制作人 D.S. Sansom 转呈人 警司 Tho Robertson

1933年4月2日，负责戈登路（Gordon Road）日本海军兵营的军官通知静安寺路巡捕房，称：

“每逢星期六、星期日及日本纪念日，允许日本海军人员在静安寺、老闸、新闸及中区漫步，日本当局将派出巡逻队以维持秩序。”

1933年4月2日上午，具名人在南京路近河南路的人行道上，观察到一支由五人组成的海军巡逻队向东行走，携带手枪、刺刀和警棍。

Sansom
D. S.

特别支部主管警官。

（批注：同日在愚园路也观察到类似的巡逻队。3月31日星期五上午，约一百名日本海军陆战队员在兆丰公园进行演习。
TR）

（左侧边缘手写字迹：Th / b/s）

1-4-33
EGGS THROWN AT
JAPANESE MARINES

There was a certain amount of
excitement near the corner of Nan-
king Road and the Bund at 5.30
p.m. yesterday when four eggs hit
a lorry in which a party of Japanese
marines was travelling. The lorry
was brought to a halt and ten of
the party jumped out and investi-
gated an alleyway which might have
held possible assailants, but found
nobody, and after a minute or two
the lorry proceeded. It is believed
that young members of the crew of
a visiting merchant ship had been
"amusing" themselves by throwing
eggs at the rickshaw coolies who
pestered them, and hit the lorry by
mistake.
N'. CHINA DAILY NEWS
pages.zh:
1933年4月1日
向日本海军陆战队员投掷鸡蛋

昨日下午5时30分，在南京路与外滩交界处附近发生了一定程度的骚动，当时有四枚鸡蛋击中了一辆载有一队日本海军陆战队员的卡车。卡车停下，队中十人跳下车，调查了一条可能藏有袭击者的小巷，但未发现任何人，一两分钟后卡车继续前行。据信，是一艘来访商船上的年轻船员在向纠缠他们的黄包车夫投掷鸡蛋“取乐”时，误中了卡车。
《字林西报》

Sir,

I beg to report that a Japanese Armed Patrol consisting
of three motor cycles with side cars carrying a machine gun on
each passed through Jinza District between 11.20a.m. and 11.30a.m.
13/9/32.

Direction of travel:-

Coming from Bubbling Well District proceeding W-E on
Bubbling Well Road turning South on to Mohawk Road then West on
Yandally Road and South onto South Chengtu Road and turning East
onto Avenue Foch, and along Avenue Edward VII into Louza District.

An ordinary Japanese Armed Patrol and did not interfere
with any thing. No Japanese residents live in this vicinity.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient Servant,
C Bishop
Inspector

D.O. "B" Division.

先生，

谨此报告，一支由三辆带边车的摩托车组成的日本武装巡逻队，每辆边车上载有一挺机枪，于1932年9月13日上午11时20分至11时30分之间穿过新闸区。

行进方向：

从静安寺区而来，沿静安寺路由西向东行驶，转入莫霍克路（Mohawk Road，今余姚路）向南，再沿延平路（Yandally Road）向西，转入成都南路向南，然后转入福煦路（Avenue Foch）向东，并沿爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII，今金陵东路）进入老闸区。

这是一支普通的日本武装巡逻队，未干涉任何事务。此附近无日本居民居住。
